scope: Human-reviewed precondition summaries tied to exact released method evidence. These are cast-entry gates, not all spell effects.

records.name: Celestial Staff
records.requirement: Player caster with a non-null block ray trace using distance input 70.
records.tip: Aim at a reachable block rather than empty sky. This does not check a clear overhead path for the later spell.

records.name: Atlantic Staff
records.requirement: At least one IMob-matching target in the caster bounding box expanded by 10 on each axis.
records.tip: Move close to an eligible hostile mob. The 10 value expands a box, not a spherical radius; this precondition does not add a line-of-sight test.

records.name: Crystik Staff
records.requirement: At least one IMob-matching target without the checked MAGIC_IMMUNE property, in a box expanded by 10.
records.tip: A nearby mob can still fail this predicate because of its explicit magic immunity property; no promise about all other defenses.

records.name: Lyonic Staff
records.requirement: At least one alive IMob in a box expanded by 10 horizontally and 1 vertically.
records.tip: Large vertical separation can exclude a target even if it looks nearby horizontally.

records.name: Crystal Staff
records.requirement: At least one eligible vulnerable player in a box expanded by 20 whose health differs from max health.
records.tip: The predicate excludes spectator, Creative and damage-disabled players. The check is health != max, not an explicit team/friendship check; success returns the whole eligible player list.

records.name: Everfight Staff
records.requirement: Caster health / max health is strictly greater than 0 and strictly less than 1.
records.tip: At full health the precondition returns null; the fraction is tested before rune payment.

records.name: Evermight Staff
records.requirement: Caster health / max health is strictly greater than 0 and strictly less than 1.
records.tip: At full health the precondition returns null; the fraction is tested before rune payment.

records.name: Reef Staff
records.requirement: The caster reports being in water.
records.tip: Rain, an ocean biome label or water nearby alone is not this check.

records.name: Sky Staff
records.requirement: The caster onGround flag is true.
records.tip: Try from a grounded position; the check does not prove clear airspace for what the spell does next.

records.name: Runic Staff
records.requirement: Caster is an EntityPlayer.
records.tip: The precondition itself adds no target check. This is not proof that every later cast action succeeds.

records.name: Warlock Staff
records.requirement: Caster is an EntityPlayer.
records.tip: The precondition itself adds no target check. This is not proof that every later cast action succeeds.

records.name: Web Staff
records.requirement: At least one active potion whose isBadEffect flag is true.
records.tip: This checks the game potion flag, not every possible harmful condition. Fire, hunger or a mod custom status is not automatically included.

records.name: Fungal Staff
records.requirement: The sampled 5×5×5 offsets around caster coordinates include grass or a BlockMushroom.
records.tip: The collected entries distinguish grass from mushrooms. This only establishes a workable list, not successful growth or placement.

records.name: Nature Staff
records.requirement: A block in the caster box expanded by 10 implements IGrowable and its canGrow(..., false) returns true.
records.tip: A fully grown crop can fail the growth predicate. Each block owns its growability rule.

records.name: Coral Staff
records.requirement: The selected surrounding shell positions contain exact vanilla AIR and pass the selected player mining-permission check.
records.tip: This is not a universal claim/protection compatibility check. The later spell places blocks, so test it away from valuable builds.
